title: Evidence manifest — manifest-rooted bundle
$comment: Every artifact listed by lcp:sha256: reference with a role. The status-list-snapshot and issuer-key-state roles are the as-of mechanism: Bitstring Status List has no historical query, so the list credential fetched at settlement time is snapshotted and verify checks the hash-pinned snapshot, never a live dereference presented as historical truth. The `referenced terms document` role is present whenever the ATR's terms slot is an lcp:sha256: reference (the TRM-2/TRM-7 reading) — a ref-terms ATR with no such entry is an incomplete bundle (fail-fast in the evidence consumer).
